sanskrit_verse:
एवं परीक्षितं सभ्यैः पूर्वपक्षं तु लेखयेत् ।
अप्रसिद्धं पुरद्विष्टं विवादं न विचारयेत् ॥१,१.१२५
transliteration: evaṁ parīkṣitaṁ sabhyaiḥ pūrvapakṣaṁ tu lekhayet | aprasiddhaṁ puradvīṣṭaṁ vivādaṁ na vicārayet ||1,1.125||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which has been examined by the assembly of knowers, that alone shall be recorded as the prior position; disputes that are unestablished or hostile to the city shall not be investigated.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from collective realization, not individual assertion
Causation must align with established integrity of the governing body
Capacity-based responsibility requires prior validation through recognized insight
Restoration logic excludes engagement with chaotic or divisive claims
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of disorder-disguised-as-inquiry
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claim lacks prior examination by a recognized council of realized beings, THEN it SHALL NOT enter judicial review
IF a dispute originates from or promotes division within the societal fabric, THEN it SHALL BE DISMISSED without deliberation
ONLY those positions validated through experiential consensus MAY be considered legitimate legal precedents
ANY assertion unaligned with the settled wisdom of the awakened assembly SHALL BE deemed inadmissible
supreme_court_application: The Supreme Court operates solely upon matters previously ratified by councils grounded in Self-realization. Cases lacking such validation, or those fostering internal discord, fall outside its jurisdiction. The threshold for admissibility rests not on volume of contention but on alignment with already-established Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is the experiential verification by the sabhyāḥ—those established in witnessing consciousness. Vivāda that arises from ignorance or malice disrupts anupūrvaśaḥ, the natural unfolding of truth. Therefore, exclusion—not punishment—is the dharmic mechanism ensuring proportional responsibility and maintaining alignment with non-retaliatory reality.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Redirect all involved parties toward practices restoring clarity and unity
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require disputants to demonstrate alignment with sabhyah before re-entry into discourse
Capacity Restoration: Facilitate purification and realization processes for individuals presenting ungrounded claims
Integrity Reintegration: Engage community-level affirmation to reaffirm established truths
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored when only verified truth enters judgment. There is no punishment—only alignment with consciousness. Reality itself adjudicates.
